title: Checking if stdin is readable on Windows
author: adrianofdoom
adrianofdoom

text:
Select on Windows only works with BSD Network Sockets as far as I recall.
You would need to the WIN32 API to figure what is stdin is readable I think.



 Adrian of Doom:

def stdin_is_readable():
    return not sys.stdin.isatty()



If you pipe into your command the stdin is not a tty.
Maybe it’s good enough to assume that if stdin is not a tty then you can read video data from stdin?
